content: browser.runtime.sendMessage()/runtime.onMessage.addListener() is the standard one-shot request/response channel between popup and background service worker; MV3 favors returning a Promise from the listener (async listener) over the legacy sendResponse+return-true callback pattern. A typed discriminated-union message shape (a 'type' or 'kind' field) dispatched via a switch/router in the background listener is the conventional pattern to avoid ad-hoc if-chains as message kinds grow.
